4806:
** συζωοποιέω**,
**quicken together with**, τινὰς τῷ Χριστῷ {{NT|NT.Eph.2.5, cf. NT.Col.2.13.}}
4809:
** σῡκόμορ-ος**, ἡ,
(μόρον) **sycamore-fig, Ficus Sycomorus**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Celsus Medicus 5.18.7; compare συκάμινος 11}}. (Heb. **shikemah.**)
4814:
** συλλᾰλ-έω**,
**talk with** or **together**, τινι {{NT+3rd c.BC+|“PCair.Zen.” 315.2 (3rd c.BC), “PHib.” 1.66.4 (3rd c.BC), LXX.Exo.34.35, 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 4.22.8; μετά τινος NT.Matt.17.3, etc.; πρός τινα NT.Luke.4.36; ἐπαχθέντες ἐπὶ τὸν δῆμον ὑπὲρ ἁπάντων “OGI” 229.23 (Smyrna, 3rd c.BC)}}; ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἐνδοῦναι {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 1.43.1.}}
4821:
** συμβᾰσῐλ-εύω**,
**rule, reign together with**, τινι {{NT+2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 30.2.4, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Lycurgus” 5, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “DDeor.” 16.2, etc.: _metaphorically_, NT.1Cor.4.8: _absolutely_, NT.2Tim.2.12.}}
4826:
**Συμεών**, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luk.2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a _Heb._ name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
1. the son of Jacob (Gen.29:33): Rev.7:7.
2. **An ancestor of our Lord**: Luk.3:30
3. **An aged worshipper in the Temple**: Luk.2:25, 34.
4. **One surnamed Niger**: Act.13:1.
5. **The apostle Peter**: Act.15:14, 2Pe.1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4827:
** συμμᾰθητής**, οῦ, ὁ,
**fellow-disciple, schoolfellow**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Euthydemus” 272c, 2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 12.835, 3rd c.AD: Pseudo-Callisthenes Historicus 1.13}}; ἐγένονθ᾽ ἑαυτῶν συμμαθηταὶ τῆς τέχνης **fellow-pupils** in the art, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Anaxippus Comicus 1.2.}}
4830:
** συμμέτ-οχος**, ον,
**partaking with** another **in** a thing, τινί τινος {{NT+1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 1.24.6, cf. NT.Eph.5.7}}: as _substantive_, **joint owner,** {{Refs 6th c.AD+|PLond. 5.1733.52 (6th c.AD).}}
4832:
** σύμμορφ-ος**, ον,
**of the same shape as**, τινι {{NT+2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Nicander Epicus “Theriaca” 321, cf. NT.Phil.3.21}}; τινος {{NT|NT.Rom.8.29}}: _absolutely_, **similar**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Am.” 39.}}
4837:
** συμπαρα-κᾰλέω**,
**call upon** or **exhort together**, ἐπὶ συμμαχίαν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 555a}}; **invite at the same time**, εἰς τὴν θήραν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Institutio Cyri (Cyropaedia)” 8.1.38}}; ἥρωας σ. οἰκήτορας **invite** them as.., {{Refs|[prev. work] 3.3.21}}; with _infinitive_, σῶσαι {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Dinarchus Orator 1.65}}; **summon at the same time**, ἀπὸ τῶν συμμάχων πρέσβεις {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Historia Graeca (Hellenica)” 4.8.13.}}
4838:
** συμπαρα-λαμβάνω**,
**take along with** one, **take in as an adjunct** or **assistant**, κοινωνόν τι σ. {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Phaedo” 65b, compare 84d, “La.” 179e, NT.Act.15.37; τινὰ ἑαυτῷ “BGU” 226.12 (1st c.AD)}}; σ. τὴν ἐκτὸς εὐετηρίαν **include in their account**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Ethica Nicomachea” 1098b26}}; τὰς τῶν προτέρων δόξας {{Refs 4th c.BC+|[prev. author] “de An.” 403b22; τὰ ὁμολογούμενα 4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “de Causis Plantarum” 5.3.7}}; σ. τοὺς ἐκτὸς τῆς πολιτείας **adopt as partisans**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Politica” 1304a16}}; **call in for advice**, φίλους {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “περὶ οἰκονομίας” p.72J.}}; in receipts, _aorist_ συνπαρέλαβα **received also by me,** {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|PRyl. 189.8 (2nd c.AD)}}:—_passive_, **to be invited**, {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC(?): Anticlides Historicus cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 4.157f, 1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 1.328, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 15.2.7}}; σ. ἐπὶ τὰ πράγματα **to be called into counsel**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 7.55}}; **to be incidentally involved**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “περὶ παρρησίας” p.29O.}}; **to be called in to help**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 2.15.}}
4839:
** συμπαρα-μένω**,
_future_ **-μενῶ**{{Refs 1st c.BC+|“PSI” 1.64.3 (1st c.BC)}}:—**stay along with** or **among**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “προρρητικόν” 2.15, “Int.” 6: with _dative_, 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 6.89, “SIG” 567 A 12 (Calymna, 3rd c.BC)}}; [γυνὴ] ἀτυχοῦντι συμπαρέμεινεν {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Menander Comicus 325.11, compare “PSI”}}[same place]; **endure as long as**, τῷ βίῳ {{Refs 4th c.AD+|4th c.AD: Julianus Imperator “Caesares” 324d.}}
4847:
** συμπολῑτ-ης**, ου, ὁ,
**fellow-citizen**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Heraclidae” 826, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 19.2.2, “IG” 14.1878 (from Rome); condemned by 2nd c.AD: Phrynichus Atticista 150}}: _feminine_ **συμπολῑτ-ῖτις**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 34 / 5.2.16, 12th c.AD: Eustathius Episcopus Thessalonicensis 119.6.}}
4853:
** συμφῡλ-έτης**, ου, ὁ,
**of the same** φυλή, {{Refs|“IG” 12(2).505.18 (from Methymna)}}: generally, **fellow-countryman**, {{NT|NT.1Thes.2.14.}}
4861:
** σύμψῡχος**, ον,
**A** **of one mind, at unity,** {{NT|NT.Phil.2.2}}; **united in soul**, τῇ γῇ {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Polemo Sophista “Callimachus” 54.}}
4869:
** συναιχμᾰλωτ-ος**, ὁ,
**fellow-prisoner,** {{NT+2nd c.AD+|NT.Rom.16.7, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Asin.” 27}}:—_feminine_ **συναιχμᾰλώτ-ωτις**, ιδος, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC-1st c.AD: Conon Historicus 13 (_plural_).}}
4874:
** συνανα-μείγνῡμι**,
**mix up together**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ γυναικείης φύσιος” 97, 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 5.177b}}:—_passive_, with _dative_, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “Historia Plantarum” 8.8.3, 1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus “D.” 3.9}}; **associate with**, τισι {{NT+4th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Clearchus Historicus 25; πόρνοις NT.1Cor.5.9}}; of two bodies of men **meeting**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Philopoemen” 21}}; ἡ ἄνοια ξ. αὐτοῖς **is part of** their **nature**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Cont.” 15.}}
4875:
** συνανα-παύομαι**,
_passive_, **sleep with**, γυναικί {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis “Ars Rhetorica” 9.4, compare 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.125a, 3rd c.AD: Heliodorus Scriptor Eroticus 6.8}}; **to be refreshed, receive comfort along with**, ὑμῖν {{NT|NT.Rom.15.32.}}
4877:
** συνάντ-ησις**, εως, ἡ,
**meeting**, {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Ion” 535 (troch.), LXX.Gen.18.2, +others, variant in NT.Matt.8.34; περὶ συναντήσεως εἰς Μέμφιν “PCair.Zen.” 541.8 (3rd c.BC)}}; κατὰ τὰς σ. in **chance-meetings**, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 4.66}}; **encounter, controversy**, πικροὶ πρὸς τὰς σ. {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ εὐσχημοσύνης” 3}}; of heavenly bodies, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Vettius Valens Astrologus 147.29, 4th c.AD: Paulus Alexandrinus Astrologus “R.” 3.}}
4880:
** συναπο-θνήσκω**,
**die together with**, τινι {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 3.16, 5.47; αἱ δυνάμεις σ. τοῖς σώμασι 5th-6th c.BC: Isocrates Orator “Epistulae” 8.5: _absolutely_, opposed to συζῆν, NT.2Cor.7.3, 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 6.249b}}; συναποθνῄσκοντες, title of comedy by Diphilus, Ter.{{Refs 5th c.BC+|“Adelph.Prol.” 6; ὧν τὰ συγγράμματα τοῖς μὲν ἤδη συναπέθανε, τοῖς δὲ συντεθνήξεται 2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 15.68; τοῦ ἀποθανόντος οὐ σ. ἡ ψυχή 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Phaedo” 88d}}; σ. νοσήματα, i.e. **cling** to one **until death**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “ἀφορισμοί” 2.39, compare 4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “de Generatione Animalium” 775b34.}}
4881:
** συναπόλλῡμι**,
**destroy together**, μετά τινος {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Antipho Orator 5.82}}; σ. τοὺς φίλους **destroy one's** friends **as well as oneself**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 6.12; συνηγόρους καλεῖν τοὺς συναπολοῦντάς τινα 4th c.BC: Hyperides Orator “pro Lycophrone” 19}}; σ. τὰ Χρήματα **lose** the money **also**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 34.2}}; τινί τι one thing **with** another, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Cat.Mi.” 38}}:—_passive_, **perish together**, {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 2.60, 5th c.BC: Lysias Orator 12.88: with _dative_, 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 7.221, 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Critias” 121a, NT.Heb.11.31.}}
4882:
** συναπο-στέλλω**,
**dispatch together with**, τινι {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 6.88; Στράτωνι νεανίσκον “PCair.Zen.” 18.5 (3rd c.BC); τινὰ μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ [prev. work] 439.3 (3rd c.BC)}}; **join in dispatching**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Isaeus Orator 6.27, 5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Historia Graeca (Hellenica)” 5.2.37, etc.}}
4883:
** συναρμολογέω**,
**compagino,** {{Refs|“Corpus Glossariorum Latinorum”}}:—_passive_, **to be fitted** or **framed together,** {{NT|NT.Eph.2.21, 4.16.}}
4891:
** συνεγείρω**,
**help in raising**, κτῆνος {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD(?): Pseudo-Phocylidea 140}}; **raise also**, νεκρούς {{NT|NT.Eph.2.6}}; **help in stirring up**, θρήνους {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.117c}}:—_passive_, **rise together**, {{LXX+NT|LXX.Isa.14.9, NT.Col.2.12, etc.}}; of an invalid, **revive**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Aristides Rhetor “Orationes” 48(24).43.}}
4897:
** συνεισ-έρχομαι**,
**enter along with** or **together**, σοὶ δόμους {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Helena” 327}}; ἐς οἴκους τινί{{Refs 5th c.BC+|[prev. work] 1083; ἐς τὸ τεῖχος 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 4.57; οἴκαδε 5th-6th c.BC: Andocides Orator 4.17}}; εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Mitteis {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“Chr.” 91 ii 26 (2nd c.AD, probably)}}; of things, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Sextus Empiricus Philosophus “Πυρρώνειοι ὑποτυπώσεις” 1.10, 2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus “de Usu Partium” 8.7, 4th c.AD: Libanius Sophista “Orationes” 64.12, etc.}}
4899:
** συνεκ-λεκτός**, ή, όν,
**chosen along with** or **together**, {{NT|NT.1Pet.5.13.}}
